literal_meaning: ফাঁদ বা দড়ির গিঁঠ (a loop or noose)
figurative_meaning_en: Expertise or firm grasp on a subject
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কম্পিউটার প্রোগ্রামিংয়ে ভালো ফাণ্ডা রাখে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has a great grip on mathematics.
She has a solid hold on computer programming.
note: This idiom derives from the literal sense of a 'loop' implying a secure hold, commonly used in everyday Bengali speech.
